Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote, EMEA)

About us
We build the scheduling and payments platform used by more than 2,000 independent clinics. Our product team is small, our customers are loyal, and we ship to production several times a day.

What you'll do
- Own features end to end, from the first conversation with a clinic owner to monitoring them in production.
- Design and build REST APIs in Laravel and the React screens that use them.
- Improve the reliability of our PostgreSQL database and our background jobs on Redis.
- Review code from teammates and help us keep the test suite fast and meaningful.
- Work with our designer in Figma to turn rough ideas into simple flows.

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience building web applications with PHP, ideally with Laravel.
- Strong experience with TypeScript and React in a production codebase.
- You are comfortable with SQL and can read a query plan.
- Experience with Docker and a CI/CD pipeline such as GitHub Actions.
- Clear written communication in English; our team works across four time zones.

Nice to have
- Experience with AWS or another cloud provider.
- You have used Stripe or another payments API before.
- Kubernetes, Terraform

What we offer
A fully remote team, a yearly learning budget, and a four-day work week in August.
